name: Fibonacci String and Intrinsic Tau-Path Equivalence
statement: The Fibonacci-string model and the intrinsic peripheral-$\Theta$ path-$\tau$ criterion define the same graph $\Gamma_n$.
proof: Peripheral $\Theta$-classes characterize simplex graphs, so $G=\kappa(R)$ for some graph $R$. The simplex-graph identity $\kappa(R)^\tau\cong\overline R$ turns $G^\tau\cong P_n$ into $R\cong\overline{P_n}$. Cliques of $\overline{P_n}$ are independent sets of $P_n$, exactly the binary strings with no consecutive ones, giving $\kappa(\overline{P_n})\cong\Gamma_n$. The same identities prove the converse.
